description: ⭐ OVER 60,000 COPIES SOLD ⭐ The Retirement Planning Guidebook is a practical, plain-English retirement planning book for people approaching or already in retirement. It helps you make confident decisions about retirement income, Social Security, Medicare, taxes, housing, long-term care, and lifestyle—so nothing important falls through the cracks. Retirement is one of the most important—and complex—financial decisions you will ever make. Unlike your working years, retirement introduces new risks, tradeoffs, and irreversible choices. Mistakes can be costly, stressful, and difficult to fix. This book helps you move beyond one-size-fits-all advice by showing how your personal retirement income style should guide every major decision you make. Inside, you’ll learn how to: • Clarify your retirement income style so you can cut through conflicting opinions and choose strategies that fit you. • Build sustainable retirement income using the right mix of investments and insurance products. • Determine if you’re truly ready to retire by aligning your assets with spending needs, legacy goals, and contingency reserves. • Make smart Social Security decisions , potentially adding $100,000 or more in lifetime benefits. • Navigate Medicare and health insurance choices , including options when retiring before Medicare eligibility. • Incorporate housing decisions —where to live and whether to tap home equity—into your retirement strategy. • Manage long-term care risks , weighing self-funding, insurance, Medicaid planning, and aging-in-place solutions. • Draw from your accounts tax-efficiently , using withdrawal sequencing, Roth conversions, tax-rate management, and gains harvesting to increase after-tax spending. • Organize your financial and estate planning , including a will, beneficiary

What if you could retire when you want, how you want, with the confidence that you’ve planned it the right way? In Retire Today , Jeremy Keil shows you how to move from confusion to confidence in five simple steps. You’ll learn how to maximize your income, minimize your taxes, and most of all, steer clear of costly retirement mistakes. description: Learn everything you need to do in the next five years to create a realistic plan for your retirement with clear, practical advice that is sure to set your future up for success. The 5 Years Before You Retire has helped thousands of people prepare for retirement—even if they waited until the last minute. In this new and updated edition, you’ll find out everything you need to do in the next five years to maximize your current savings and create a realistic plan for your future. title: Retirement Planning for Women: The No-Nonsense Guide to Catching Up, Getting Ahead and Ret
description: Your life was never taken into consideration while creating retirement plans. The majority of financial advice is predicated on a straight line: unbroken contributions, consistent full-time employment from your twenties through your sixties, and having someone else manage "the numbers" while you take care of everything else. However, it is seldom the complete story. pauses in work to provide care. years of being paid less for doing the same job. An extended life expectancy necessitates that your funds go further rather than shorter. Additionally, many women experience an unforeseen phase of life later in life, such as divorce or widowhood, when they must make financial choices on their own, sometimes without prior notice. That is the reality for which this book was intended. Whether you're starting late, starting anew, or just beginning to pay attention for the first time, Retirement Planning for Women: The No-Nonsense Guide to Catching Up, Getting Ahead, and Retiring on Your Own Terms is an objective, judgment-free guide to bridging the retirement gap at every age or stage. You'll learn why this gap exists, how to develop true financial confidence, and exactly what to do next in fifteen chapters divided into three sections. These chapters will cover everything from catch-up contribution strategies and overlooked Social Security provisions to wise, stress-free investing, safeguarding your existing assets, and boosting your income at any stage of your career. This book, which combines relevant, real-world problems with grounded psychological understanding and specific, doable procedures, is written in a pleasant, practical manner devoid of jargon, guilt, or scare tactics.
